# Package layering

Dependencies point strictly downward. A package may depend only on packages in a lower layer; equal-layer and upward edges fail `pnpm generate:check`.

```mermaid
graph TD
  "@product-map/spec"
  "@product-map/runtime"
  "@product-map/discovery"
  "@product-map/extract"
  "@product-map/derive"
  "@product-map/emit"
  "@product-map/engine"
  "product-map"
  "@product-map/derive" --> "@product-map/spec"
  "@product-map/discovery" --> "@product-map/runtime"
  "@product-map/discovery" --> "@product-map/spec"
  "@product-map/emit" --> "@product-map/spec"
  "@product-map/engine" --> "@product-map/derive"
  "@product-map/engine" --> "@product-map/discovery"
  "@product-map/engine" --> "@product-map/emit"
  "@product-map/engine" --> "@product-map/extract"
  "@product-map/engine" --> "@product-map/runtime"
  "@product-map/engine" --> "@product-map/spec"
  "@product-map/extract" --> "@product-map/discovery"
  "@product-map/extract" --> "@product-map/runtime"
  "@product-map/extract" --> "@product-map/spec"
  "product-map" --> "@product-map/derive"
  "product-map" --> "@product-map/discovery"
  "product-map" --> "@product-map/emit"
  "product-map" --> "@product-map/engine"
  "product-map" --> "@product-map/extract"
  "product-map" --> "@product-map/runtime"
  "product-map" --> "@product-map/spec"
```

| Layer | Package                  | Published | Depends on                                                                                                                                                       |

| 1     | `@product-map/discovery` | no        | `@product-map/runtime`, `@product-map/spec`                                                                                                                      |
| 2     | `@product-map/extract`   | no        | `@product-map/discovery`, `@product-map/runtime`, `@product-map/spec`                                                                                            |
| 2     | `@product-map/derive`    | no        | `@product-map/spec`                                                                                                                                              |
| 2     | `@product-map/emit`      | no        | `@product-map/spec`                                                                                                                                              |
| 3     | `@product-map/engine`    | no        | `@product-map/derive`, `@product-map/discovery`, `@product-map/emit`, `@product-map/extract`, `@product-map/runtime`, `@product-map/spec`                        |
